verses.ar: اِنَّا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنَا نُوۡحًا اِلٰي قَوۡمِهٖ٘ اَنۡ اَنۡذِرۡ قَوۡمَكَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِ اَنۡ يَّاۡتِيَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌ
verses.en: We sent Noah to his People (with the Command): "Do thou warn thy People before there comes to them a grievous Penalty

verses.ar: قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اِنِّيۡ لَكُمۡ نَذِيۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌۙ‏
verses.en: He said: "O my People! I am to you a Warner, clear and open

verses.ar: اَنِ اعۡبُدُوا اللّٰهَ وَاتَّقُوۡهُ وَاَطِيۡعُوۡنِۙ‏
verses.en: That ye should worship Allah, fear Him and obey me

verses.ar: يَغۡفِرۡ لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ ذُنُوۡبِكُمۡ وَيُؤَخِّرۡكُمۡ اِلٰ٘ي اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّيؕ اِنَّ اَجَلَ اللّٰهِ اِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُۘ لَوۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.en: So He may forgive you your sins and give you respite for a stated Term: for when the Term given by Allah is accomplished, it cannot be put forward: if ye only knew

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّيۡ دَعَوۡتُ قَوۡمِيۡ لَيۡلًا وَّنَهَارًاۙ‏
verses.en: He said: "O my Lord! I have called to my People night and day

verses.ar: فَلَمۡ يَزِدۡهُمۡ دُعَآءِيۡ٘ اِلَّا فِرَارًا
verses.en: But my call only increases (their) flight (from the Right)

verses.ar: وَاِنِّيۡ كُلَّمَا دَعَوۡتُهُمۡ لِتَغۡفِرَ لَهُمۡ جَعَلُوۡ٘ا اَصَابِعَهُمۡ فِيۡ٘ اٰذَانِهِمۡ وَاسۡتَغۡشَوۡا ثِيَابَهُمۡ وَاَصَرُّوۡا وَاسۡتَكۡبَرُوا اسۡتِكۡبَارًاۚ‏
verses.en: And every time I have called to them, that Thou mightest forgive them, they have (only) thrust their fingers into their ears, covered themselves up with their garments, grown obstinate, and given themselves up to arrogance

verses.ar: ثُمَّ اِنِّيۡ دَعَوۡتُهُمۡ جِهَارًاۙ‏
verses.en: So I have called to them aloud

verses.ar: ثُمَّ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَعۡلَنۡتُ لَهُمۡ وَاَسۡرَرۡتُ لَهُمۡ اِسۡرَارًاۙ‏
verses.en: Further I have spoken to them in public and secretly in private

verses.ar: فَقُلۡتُ اسۡتَغۡفِرُوۡا رَبَّكُمۡࣞ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ غَفَّارًاۙ‏
verses.en: Saying, 'Ask forgiveness from your Lord; for He is Oft-Forgiving

verses.ar: يُّرۡسِلِ السَّمَآءَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ مِّدۡرَارًاۙ‏
verses.en: He will send rain to you in abundance

verses.ar: وَّيُمۡدِدۡكُمۡ بِاَمۡوَالٍ وَّبَنِيۡنَ وَيَجۡعَلۡ لَّكُمۡ جَنّٰتٍ وَّيَجۡعَلۡ لَّكُمۡ اَنۡهٰرًاؕ‏
verses.en: Give you increase in wealth and sons; and bestow on you gardens and bestow on you rivers (of flowing water)

verses.ar: مَا لَكُمۡ لَا تَرۡجُوۡنَ لِلّٰهِ وَقَارًاۚ‏
verses.en: What is the matter with you, that ye place not your hope for kindness and long-suffering in Allah

verses.ar: وَقَدۡ خَلَقَكُمۡ اَطۡوَارًا
verses.en: Seeing that it is He that has created you in diverse stages

verses.ar: اَلَمۡ تَرَوۡا كَيۡفَ خَلَقَ اللّٰهُ سَبۡعَ سَمٰوٰتٍ طِبَاقًاۙ‏
verses.en: See ye not how Allah has created the seven heavens one above another

verses.ar: وَّجَعَلَ الۡقَمَرَ فِيۡهِنَّ نُوۡرًا وَّجَعَلَ الشَّمۡسَ سِرَاجًا
verses.en: And made the moon a light in their midst, and made the sun as a (Glorious) Lamp

verses.ar: وَاللّٰهُ اَنۭۡ بَتَكُمۡ مِّنَ الۡاَرۡضِ نَبَاتًاۙ‏
verses.en: And Allah has produced you from the earth growing (gradually)

verses.ar: ثُمَّ يُعِيۡدُكُمۡ فِيۡهَا وَيُخۡرِجُكُمۡ اِخۡرَاجًا
verses.en: And in the End He will return you into the (earth), and raise you forth (again at the Resurrection)

verses.ar: وَاللّٰهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الۡاَرۡضَ بِسَاطًاۙ‏
verses.en: And Allah has made the earth for you as a carpet (spread out)

verses.ar: لِّتَسۡلُكُوۡا مِنۡهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًاࣖ‏
verses.en: That ye may go about therein, in spacious roads

verses.ar: قَالَ نُوۡحٌ رَّبِّ اِنَّهُمۡ عَصَوۡنِيۡ وَاتَّبَعُوۡا مَنۡ لَّمۡ يَزِدۡهُ مَالُهٗ وَوَلَدُهٗ٘ اِلَّا خَسَارًاۚ‏
verses.en: Noah said: "O my Lord! They have disobeyed me, but they follow (men) whose wealth and children give them no increase but only Loss

verses.ar: وَمَكَرُوۡا مَكۡرًا كُبَّارًاۚ‏
verses.en: And they have devised a tremendous Plot

verses.ar: وَقَالُوۡا لَا تَذَرُنَّ اٰلِهَتَكُمۡ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَّلَا سُوَاعًا ࣢ۙ وَّلَا يَغُوۡثَ وَيَعُوۡقَ وَنَسۡرًاۚ‏
verses.en: And they have said (to each other), 'Abandon not your gods: Abandon neither Wadd nor Suwa', neither Yaguth nor Ya'uq, nor Nasr

verses.ar: وَقَدۡ اَضَلُّوۡا كَثِيۡرًا ࣢ۚ وَلَا تَزِدِ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ اِلَّا ضَلٰلًا
verses.en: They have already misled many; and grant Thou no increase to the wrong-doers but in straying (from their mark)

verses.ar: مِمَّا خَطِيۡٓـٰٔتِهِمۡ اُغۡرِقُوۡا فَاُدۡخِلُوۡا نَارًا ࣢ۙ فَلَمۡ يَجِدُوۡا لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ اَنۡصَارًا
verses.en: Because of their sins they were drowned (in the flood), and were made to enter the Fire (of Punishment): and they found- in lieu of Allah- none to help them

verses.ar: وَقَالَ نُوۡحٌ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرۡ عَلَي الۡاَرۡضِ مِنَ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ دَيَّارًا
verses.en: And Noah, said: "O my Lord! Leave not of the Unbelievers, a single one on earth

verses.ar: اِنَّكَ اِنۡ تَذَرۡهُمۡ يُضِلُّوۡا عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوۡ٘ا اِلَّا فَاجِرًا كَفَّارًا
verses.en: For, if Thou dost leave (any of) them, they will but mislead Thy devotees, and they will breed none but wicked ungrateful ones

verses.ar: رَبِّ اغۡفِرۡ لِيۡ وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَنۡ دَخَلَ بَيۡتِيَ مُؤۡمِنًا وَّلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ وَالۡمُؤۡمِنٰتِؕ وَلَا تَزِدِ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ اِلَّا تَبَارًاࣖ‏
verses.en: O my Lord! Forgive me, my parents, all who enter my house in Faith, and (all) believing men and believing women: and to the wrong-doers grant Thou no increase but in perdition
